ManageSets.search: Search by set name, code, type, or release date

move.top: Move selected set to the top
move.bottom: Move selected set to the bottom

button.useSorting: Use the current sorting as the set priority instead

tooltip.useSorting: Sorts the set priority using the same column

ManageSets.sortNote: Sorting by column allows you to find a set while not changing set priority. To enable ordering again, click the column header until this message disappears.

hints.title: Hints
hints.selection: Ctrl-click or Shift-click to select several sets. From the keyboard, the arrow keys move and select, Shift extends the selection, Ctrl moves without selecting, Space selects and Ctrl+A selects every set shown.
hints.deckEditor: Deck Editor: printings from enabled sets are offered first.
hints.cardArt: Card Art: image priority is decided in the following order: first the printing a card was chosen with, then the enabled sets in this list (top to bottom), then disabled sets.

ManageSets.empty: No sets loaded. Import a card database first.

error.save: Could not save the set preferences: {error}
